description.value: Sushi Giwa is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby serving a full menu from late morning through the evening seven days a week. The restaurant offers online ordering and occasional promotional deals. It sits along a busy commercial corridor that touring cyclists travelling the Hastings Street corridor may find convenient for a sit-down meal.
